title: Phase 5E.3 assignment failure analysis and parameter sensitivity
seed_policy: one fixed seed (17) per frozen 5E.2 scenario; each parameter comparison reuses the exact same generated audio/TOA observations

metric_definitions.first_order_detection_recall: extracted candidate mapped post hoc to a first-order simulator path / all simulated first-order paths
metric_definitions.association_precision: correct first-order wall assignments / all assigned detection-wall pairs
metric_definitions.association_recall_on_detected_first_ord: correct assigned first-order candidates / extracted candidates mapped post hoc to first-order paths
metric_definitions.association_accuracy_on_classified_detec: correct first-order wall assignments plus known clutter left unassigned / detections mapped post hoc to first-/higher-order paths or injected false set
metric_definitions.false_assignment_rate: wrong-wall first-order assignments plus assigned higher-order/injected detections / all assignments
metric_definitions.missed_first_order_path_count: all simulated first-order paths minus correctly associated detected first-order paths; includes extraction misses
metric_definitions.unmatched_predicted_wall_path_count: six times microphone/event pairs minus assigned wall predictions (or estimator's equivalent count)
metric_definitions.dimension_error: estimated minus simulator dimensions, used only after fitting; strict pass requires status converged, physical validity, max absolute error <=0.05 m and max per-axis percent <=2%

oracle_dimension_fit_diagnostic.limitations: Uses post-hoc simulator labels only to isolate dimension fitting on extracted detections.
